WITH step2_account_freq_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    trans.account_id,
    account.frequency,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN trans.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN trans.amount
      WHEN trans.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -trans.amount
      ELSE NULL
    END) AS account_group_avg
  FROM trans
  INNER JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
  GROUP BY trans.account_id, account.frequency
),
step4_freq_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    frequency,
    AVG(account_group_avg) AS freq_group_avg
  FROM step2_account_freq_avg
  WHERE account_group_avg IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY frequency
)
SELECT 
  step2_account_freq_avg.account_id,
  step2_account_freq_avg.frequency,
  step2_account_freq_avg.account_group_avg,
  step2_account_freq_avg.account_group_avg / step4_freq_avg.freq_group_avg AS quotient
FROM step2_account_freq_avg
INNER JOIN step4_freq_avg ON step2_account_freq_avg.frequency = step4_freq_avg.frequency
ORDER BY CASE WHEN quotient IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, quotient DESC
LIMIT 10    -- rows returned match the question's requirement for the first 10 results
